description: This file contains utility functions and constants for handling map layers, color schemes, and data bucketing in a deck.gl-based mapping application within the Superset project. It includes functions for computing breakpoints, color scaling, and creating tile layers.

methods.name: getBreakPoints
methods.description: Calculates breakpoints for data classification, either from provided break points or by evenly distributing based on data extent and number of buckets.

methods.name: getBreakPointColorScaler
methods.description: Creates a color scaler function based on breakpoints and color scheme, supporting both threshold and linear scales.

methods.name: getBuckets
methods.description: Generates data buckets with associated colors based on breakpoints and accessor function.

methods.name: getColorBreakpointsBuckets
methods.description: Converts an array of color breakpoints into a bucketed color mapping.

methods.name: buildTileLayer
methods.description: Constructs a deck.gl TileLayer with custom rendering of bitmap sublayers for map tiles.
